parameters.query: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contacts WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days') as new_leads_7d, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contacts WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days') as new_leads_30d, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contacts WHERE lead_status = 'customer') as total_customers, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contacts WHERE lead_score >= 80) as hot_leads, (SELECT ROUND(AVG(lead_score)) FROM contacts WHERE lead_status NOT IN ('lost')) as avg_lead_score, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM deals WHERE stage NOT IN ('closed_won','closed_lost')) as active_deals, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(deal_value),0) FROM deals WHERE stage NOT IN ('closed_won','closed_lost')) as pipeline_value, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(deal_value),0) FROM deals WHERE stage = 'closed_won' AND updated_at > date_trunc('month', NOW())) as revenue_mtd, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(deal_value),0) FROM deals WHERE stage = 'closed_won' AND updated_at > date_trunc('month', NOW()) - INTERVAL '1 month' AND updated_at < date_trunc('month', NOW())) as revenue_last_month, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM deals WHERE stage = 'closed_won' AND updated_at > date_trunc('month', NOW())) as deals_won_mtd, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM deals WHERE stage = 'closed_lost' AND updated_at > date_trunc('month', NOW())) as deals_lost_mtd, (SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE stage='closed_won')::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE stage IN ('closed_won','closed_lost')),0) * 100) FROM deals WHERE updated_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days') as win_rate_30d

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tracked_keywords WHERE is_active = true) as tracked_keywords, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM keyword_rankings kr JOIN tracked_keywords tk ON tk.id = kr.keyword_id WHERE kr.position <= 10 AND kr.checked_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 day') as top10_keywords, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM keyword_rankings kr JOIN tracked_keywords tk ON tk.id = kr.keyword_id WHERE kr.position <= 3 AND kr.checked_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 day') as top3_keywords, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM backlinks WHERE is_active = true) as total_backlinks, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM backlinks WHERE first_seen > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days') as new_backlinks_7d, (SELECT ROUND(AVG(domain_rating)) FROM backlinks WHERE is_active = true) as avg_backlink_dr

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM audit_logs WHERE action LIKE '%email_sent%' AND created_at > date_trunc('month', NOW())) as emails_sent_mtd, (SELECT metrics->>'rates' FROM analytics_snapshots WHERE source = 'email_deliverability' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1) as latest_email_rates, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workflow_execution_stats WHERE status = 'error' AND started_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours') as errors_24h, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workflow_execution_stats WHERE started_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours') as executions_24h
